bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 169, Number 60 (Thursday, April 6, 2023)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. POSEY:
H.R. 2516.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article I, Section 8, Clause 18 of the United States
Constitution
The single subject of this legislation is:
Government Operations and Politics
[Page H1711]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on House Administration, and in addition to the Committee on Oversight and Accountability, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

bill.title: End the Congressional Revolving Door Act
